<page>
Marshall & Dominguez LLP
Pearland, TX
Phone 281-555-1704
Letter of Representation
April 21, 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1236
Our client: Richard Smith
Date of loss: February 23, 2024
Dear Claims Representative:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that
occurred while our client was changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving
medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client
directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person.
We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy that applies to the
at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declaraitons page and confirmation of any other coverage that may be
available. Please also identify the claim number assigned to this loss and the name of the adjuster handling the file.
We further ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes
photographs, vehicle data, dash camera footage, telematics information, witness statements, recorded calls, repair
estimates, and any claim notes. Please ensure that no vehicle involved is repaired, salvaged, or disposed of without
prior written notice to this office. We look forward to your prompt written response.
Sincerely,
Kyle Sanders
Marshall & Dominguez LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
